$comment: Mission 1.68 §25, §30, §44 and §45. At most one construct may be selected, and §30 forbids choosing the least bad merely to progress.

hard_conditions.$comment: §25. All ten must hold for STRUCTURALLY_VIABLE.
conditions: at least TWO apparatus routes are PLAUSIBLE
both can target the same population
both can target the same observation-window semantics
predicate is deterministically observable on both

why_nothing_was_selected: Every candidate failed hard condition 3. Each has exactly one plausible apparatus route, and §44 permits selection only at two or more. §30 forbids selecting the least bad to make progress, and C1 — the closest — would have been exactly that choice.

the_construct_that_came_closest.why: One well-documented route with dated immutable per-port artifacts, and a second route that is UNRESOLVED rather than BLOCKED on two separate apparatuses.
the_construct_that_came_closest.what_would_change_it: A first-party sentence stating whether Netlas or Censys represents a port that accepted a TCP connection and returned no application data. If either does, C1 has two routes.
the_construct_that_came_closest.why_it_was_not_selected_anyway: Because that sentence was not found, and selecting on the expectation that it exists would preregister an experiment on a route nobody has established.

why_no_selected_construct_artifact: §47 item 7 creates selected-construct-v1.json only if a construct is selected. None was.

current_ssh_construct_outcome.$comment: §31. The control was not exempted and was not suppressed. It has one plausible route, Netlas, which is one more than zero and one fewer than two.

requirement_registry.$comment: §33. A reusable apparatus failure mode was noticed and NOT added, in the shape Mission 1.66.2 used before Mission 1.67 adopted its rule.

candidate_offered_and_not_added.name: A_PUBLISHED_SURFACE_IS_THE_SALEABLE_OBSERVATION_NOT_THE_MEASUREMENT_PIPELINE
candidate_offered_and_not_added.candidate_meaning: Where an apparatus performs a multi-stage measurement and publishes only the stage its customers buy, the earlier stages are not retrievable however thoroughly they are performed. An apparatus may run exactly the probe a construct needs and expose only the conclusion drawn from it.
candidate_offered_and_not_added.why_it_was_not_added: It is a real and reusable observation, and it is supported here by one apparatus class evaluated in one mission. APPARATUS_CONFIGURATION_MUST_BE_UNIFORM_ACROSS_THE_FRAME was offered by Mission 1.66.2 and adopted only when Mission 1.67 found a second independent instance in a different shape. The same standard applies to this one, and it has one shape so far.
candidate_offered_and_not_added.how_it_would_be_demonstrated: A second apparatus class where the measurement pipeline is documented and an intermediate stage is provably unretrievable.
candidate_offered_and_not_added.recorded_for: a future mission with the apparatus contract legitimately in scope

primary_outcome_reasoning.why_not_A_or_B_or_C_or_D: No construct reached two plausible apparatus routes, so none was selected. §45 says not to force a positive selection.
primary_outcome_reasoning.why_not_F_class_insufficient: F requires the analysis to ESTABLISH that the apparatus class itself is the dominant limitation. The evidence points that way and does not establish it: several cells are UNRESOLVED rather than BLOCKED, and a single documented sentence about how a no-response open port is represented would give C1 two routes. Reporting F would convert 'this mission could not establish it' into 'it cannot be done', which is the conversion this repository has refused since Mission 1.60.
primary_outcome_reasoning.what_E_explicitly_does_not_mean: It does not mean no such construct exists, and it does not mean the scanner class is exhausted. It means that within five constructs, seven apparatuses and eleven documents, no construct reached two plausible routes.

mission_accounting.$comment: §28 and the STOP condition. Every counter, including the ones that must be zero.
mission_accounting.value_exposure_note: No documentation example containing a target count was used to choose a construct, and none was read for that purpose. The Sonar study page shows a file count and file sizes, which are artifact metadata rather than measurement values, and no such figure entered any comparison.

parallel_state_untouched.a_sent_question_is_not_an_answer: ONYPHE's outstanding enquiry improves no gate in this mission's matrix, and its unresolved B2 and B4 are carried exactly as recorded.

recommended_next_mission.recommended: Mission 1.69 — Independent Product-Relevant Quantity Class Selection V1
recommended_next_mission.why: §52 is explicit that this branch recommends a strategic pivot mission which may leave the internet-scanner apparatus class entirely. Five constructs over seven apparatuses each reached exactly one route, and a sixth construct in the same class is more of the same experiment.

the_one_cheap_thing_worth_doing_first.question: Does any apparatus publish, as a separately addressable artifact, a record that a port accepted a TCP connection without producing an application response?
the_one_cheap_thing_worth_doing_first.why_it_is_worth_asking: It is the single question that would give C1 two routes, it is narrow, and two apparatuses are UNRESOLVED rather than BLOCKED on it.
the_one_cheap_thing_worth_doing_first.how_it_would_be_answered: First-party documentation, or the enquiry channel this project has already used once. It does not need a new discovery sweep.
